description: Figure 9 presents a bar chart illustrating the effect of context masking perturbations, categorized by grammatical tag, with error bars indicating the standard deviation for each category. The horizontal axis displays the different tags, listed in the order: NOUN, PROPN, VERB, ADJ, ADV, NUM, PRON, and PART. The vertical axis represents the effect size as a percentage, scaled linearly from -100% to +100%, with tick marks at intervals of 50%. Each bar corresponds to a specific tag and its approximate effect value: NOUN shows an effect of approximately +20%, PROPN shows approximately +30%, VERB shows approximately +10%, ADJ shows approximately +5%, ADV shows approximately +15%, NUM shows approximately +25%, PRON shows approximately +10%, and PART shows approximately +35%. The bars are colored uniformly in a solid blue and are arranged in descending order of their effect values, with the tallest bar (PART) on the far right and the shortest bar (VERB) on the far left. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their height and error bars.
